from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """A financial report entry capturing the operating cash flow for a single company."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity filing the report")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line-item label from the financial statements (e.g. 'Net cash provided by operating activities')")
    cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the operating cash flow as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the data (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text excerpt containing the value for grounding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted financial report entries."""
    cash_flow_reports: list[CompanyCashFlow]
